title: Gigi Pasta
ingredients: 1/4 cup olive oil (this is too much oil)
directions:
Step 1- Cook tomato and aromatics. Add the garlic and onion to a large saucepan. Once soft, add the tomato paste and cook briefly. 
Step 2- Build the sauce. Add the cream and vodka and simmer until the alcohol evaporates. Add the seasonings, stir, and remove from the heat. 
Step 3- Cook the pasta. In a large pot, cook the pasta to al dente, strain, and reserve ¼ cup of the pasta water. 
Step 4- Combine. Fold in the butter and stir until it melts, then add the pasta, reserved pasta water, and parmesan. Once combined, serve with fresh herbs.

directions: Mix the lemon juice, vinegar, olive oil and salt for the dressing. I store it separately so the salad stays fresh longer.

title: Beef Udon Soup
ingredients: 2 cups dashi (2 cups water 1 tbsp dashi powder)
⅛ tsp Diamond Crystal kosher salt
6–8 oz thinly sliced beef (such as ribeye) (or learn how to slice meat thinly at home)
2 servings udon noodles (1.1 lb/500 g frozen or parboiled udon noodles; 6.3 oz/180 g dry udon noodles)

title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
ingredients: 1 lb chicken breasts (2 medium), or leftover rotisserie chicken
15 oz can corn, drained and rinsed
15 oz can black beans, drained and rinsed
1/3 cup cilantro, chopped, plus more to garnish
1 1/2 Tbsp lime juice, from 1 lime, or to taste
directions:
Tortilla Strips: Preheat a pan with 1/4 cup oil over medium-high heat. Cut tortillas into thin strips and fry in batches until crisp. Drain on a paper towel. Set aside.
Soup: Preheat a pot or dutch oven with olive oil over medium-high heat. Add onion, garlic, and jalapeño; sauté until softened.
Add chicken broth, crushed tomatoes, chicken breasts, corn, beans, chili powder, cumin, and salt. Bring to a boil and simmer ~20 minutes until chicken is cooked through and easy to shred.
Remove chicken, shred with 2 forks, return to pot, and simmer 5 more minutes. Remove from heat and stir in cilantro and lime juice.
Serve topped with tortilla strips, diced avocado, fresh cilantro, and lime wedges.

title: Gallo Pinto
description: Costa Rican beans and rice. Great with fried or scrambled eggs.
ingredients: 2 Tbsp light-tasting oil (vegetable, mild olive, or canola)
2 cups cooked black beans, in 3/4 cup reserved cooking liquid
3 cups cooked rice (preferably day-old and refrigerated)
directions:
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Sauté bell pepper and onion until peppers are soft and onions are translucent, about 6-8 minutes. Add garlic and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add black beans, reserved cooking liquid, and Salsa Lizano. Stir to combine and simmer 5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Gently stir in cooked rice and cook until heated through and most of the liquid is absorbed, about 3-5 minutes.
Stir in cilantro. Season with additional Salsa Lizano to taste and serve.
